boost_definition: Intel boost_ghz is the ARK Max Turbo Frequency (the headline 'up to' figure). For K-series chips this includes Thermal Velocity Boost / Turbo Boost Max 3.0, so it is higher than the P-core-only Max Turbo (for example i7-13700K: Max Turbo 5.4 GHz, P-core Max Turbo 5.3 GHz). AMD boost_ghz is the Max Boost Clock. e_core_boost_ghz is Intel's E-core turbo figure: Efficient-core Max Turbo Frequency (12th-14th gen and Core Ultra 200HX and 200H), Single E-core Turbo Frequency (Core Ultra desktop), Low Power Efficient-core Max Turbo Frequency (Core Ultra 200V and Core Ultra Series 3 non-H models, which have no standard E-cores). A rated boost clock is a spec-sheet maximum, not a guaranteed sustained clock: it depends on thermals, power limits and core count.

gpu_tdp_definition: tdp_w is NVIDIA's Total Graphics Power / Graphics Card Power / TDP, AMD's Typical Board Power (Desktop).
